eps.o: Gizelle brings the group together to process Karen's trial and sentencing, but the conversation shifts toward relationships; Keiarna and Stacey circle the block on love; Ashley hosts her first big outing as newly divorced woman.

Stacey finds herself in hot water with the ladies who try and separate her facts from fiction; Keiarna's frustrations with Wendy affect her friendship with Angel; Angel hosts a retreat to try and mend.

Wendy and Keiarna try to find common ground, but dueling events put them at odds with one another; Stacey discovers a secret Gizelle has been hiding from the group; tensions boil over at a brunch when Angel's loyalties are called into question.

The ladies jet off to Nevis; Angel struggles to find her place in the group while Gizelle questions her and Stacey; Keiarna deals with the fallout of her feuds with Wendy and Jassi; Stacey claps back at Gizelle with swirling rumors of a tryst.
The ladies end their first night in Nevis with a celebration; a day filled with sunshine, history and shopping isn't enough to shake Keiarna and Angel's feelings of uneasiness within the group.

On the final day in Nevis, the group hits the high seas; Gizelle attempts to broker peace between several of the women; Tia has a surprising confrontation at dinner; the ladies throw a raunchy bachelorette party to celebrate Jassi.

Stacey unveils her new line of gummies, but the brand name gives the ladies cause for pause; Wendy gets candid about her father; Keiarna and Greg discuss the state of their relationship; Angel and Tia connect with their families.

Monique gets reacquainted with her Potomac crew, but gets more than she bargained for with some of the ladies. Stacey introduces Tia to Thiemo with interesting results. At Gizelle’s Reasonably Shady party, Keiarna and Tia confront Stacey about her pattern of inconsistency.

The ladies continue to press Stacey about spreading rumors. Angel confronts Wendy about their strained relationship. While Ashley worries about her mother’s well-being, Wendy contemplates her future with her father. Monique sits down with the group to solve the mystery of the Potomac leak once and for all.

Gizelle and Monique sit down for a long overdue one-on-one. Ashley has a heart-to-heart with Josh and navigates familial issues. Stacey hosts a launch event for her gummy line, but a notable absence and additional scrutiny from Tia heighten tensions in the group.

Tia treats the ladies to a proper day of polo; Angel is blindsided by a sudden change to her move-in plans; Gizelle and Wendy organize a "Potomac and Ponies" theme day, but the gossip about one rumor reaches a boiling point.

Ashley reconnects with an old flame at the "Potomac and Ponies" Family Fun Day, while Keiarna and Greg celebrate a milestone moment. Tia seeks to repair her relationship with her half-sister, and Wendy’s attempt to make peace with her father sparks a major blowout.

As Angel and her family prepare to move back to Colorado, she shifts her focus to hosting the ladies for their upcoming getaway. Tia goes down a tearful memory lane with her sister. Monique stirs the pot with a shady binder reveal event that sends allegations flying and puts Angel and Ashley at odds. Tensions rise as the women travel to Colorado with hopes that Angel can meet their expectations.

The ladies continue their trip to Colorado with a welcome mixer at Angel’s picturesque home. Monique draws unique parallels between her life and Angel’s. Chaos ensues when the guest house girls encounter a problem with their accommodations, leaving them feeling like they’ve been left high and dry by their host.

On day two of the Colorado getaway, the group heads to Aspen for a day of fun, but not before a confrontation over the guest house accommodations. Monique voices her opinion about Angel’s personal life. Gizelle sets her sights on taking over as host for the remainder of the trip.

As the Colorado trip comes to an end, the ladies are racing against the clock to make it to their final excursion, but things don’t go as planned after Angel takes a wrong turn. Stacey’s character is once again questioned, but this time by one of her closest allies.
Newly released from prison, Karen Huger sits down for a no-holds barred interview with Andy Cohen to discuss what led to her arrest, the realities of prison life, and what's in store for her future.

While the women of Potomac gather to discuss Season 10, the topic on everyone's mind is Wendy's recent legal woes. Stacey is held accountable for her season of alleged loose truths. Angel confronts the women in regards to her treatment in the friend group. Tensions with Ashley boil over.
Ashley continues to defend her reaction to Wendy's legal challenges and is later confronted about other moments; Keiarna gives an update on her life with Greg.
The women revisit the Colorado trip and Angel explains what could have been done differently.
